head: codex/5605-v0-91-8-podcast-revive-ai-agent-podcast-weekly-cadence
title: [v0.91.8][podcast] Prepare weekly AI agent podcast launch plan
body:
Closes #5605

Prepares the AI agent podcast revival for weekly launch readiness without claiming live publication. The docs inventory the old v0.91.1/v0.91.3 podcast evidence, define the future `agent-logic.ai/podcast` route and studio launch gates, and capture the first ten approachable topic candidates including the week-two DeepSeek invitation option.

Validation:
- referenced historical and new podcast paths exist
- `bash adl/tools/demo_v0913_podcast_studio_v2.sh`
- `bash adl/tools/test_podcast_studio_v2_packet.sh`
- `git diff --check` plus docs secret/host-path hygiene scan
- bounded subagent review clean after lifecycle metadata hygiene repair

Non-claims: no live website route, RSS feed, audio publication, guest acceptance, or durable weekly cadence is claimed by this planning issue.
